shared_elements: human figures shown in profile/frontal schematic form
figures with raised or extended arms
elongated vertical object held or standing between figures (staff/pole)
justification: Both surfaces show schematic human figures with arms raised or extended and small repeated sign-like marks, and both include an elongated vertical element near figures, but these are generic to almost any figural tradition. A is a loose scatter of stick-like painted figures, circles and a boat-like curve with no registers or framing, while B is a strictly ordered composition of two proportioned, clothed profile figures facing each other across an offering stand above ruled bands of writing.
